rule.code: eval/tsdesk_goal.py (this commit), applied to stored results only
rule.G1_accuracy: for each of dev, dense_dev (the candidate at one input policy of its own, the same for both) and dev_l544, dense_dev_l544 (the same candidate at fit:960 on the resized frames): CER <= R's CER on the same frames (point), and the paired interval (candidate - R) not entirely above 0; on dev and dev_l544 the vita and psp views' intervals each not entirely above 0
rule.G2_detector_speed: the candidate's detector + refinement in the C AVX2 build (-O3 -march=x86-64-v3), 1 thread, p50 on the 960x544 timing pages <= MeikiOCR's detector (ONNX Runtime, 1 thread, graph optimisations on, its own preprocessing) p50 on the same pages / 5, both measured in one interleaved run
rule.G3_page_speed: the candidate's full page (detector + VOCR6.2-L on every line, C or ONNX path, its best) at 4 threads, p50 <= R's page at a 4-thread budget / 3, on each of the Vita, PSP and PC timing pages, in one interleaved run
rule.G4_guards: junk boxes on hval's PCSG00854 <= R's (R: 0 in round 1's read); on dev and dev_l544 the vita and psp views each not resolved worse than T8 (interval of candidate - T8 not entirely above 0)
rule.report: peak RAM (C and ONNX), p95 times, per-view CERs, exact boxes, MeikiOCR itself, d64 where read
rule.met_on_dev: G1-G4 all pass for one candidate; then the confirmation reads (above) decide the claim
rule.confirmation_rule: the claim stands when on the PC test set (own size and l544) and confirm-v2 (own size and l544) the candidate's CER is <= R's (point) and no interval of candidate - R is entirely above 0; if a confirmation fails: no tuning on it, work continues on dev, and fresh test data is asked of desktop-data's importer (the owner's captures through desktopdata/owner.py, or a new held-out carve) before the next claim, recorded here as an amendment

rounds.procedure: each round registers its studies and arms as an amendment (what, which sets, how the next step is chosen) before reading them; reads are logged in vocr6/experiments.jsonl; the round ends with a summary on #173 (numbers against R and T8, what was learned, the next round); status lines start with ROUND<n>
rounds.selection: within a round, arms are compared on the goal's quantities on dev data (hval and dense_screen first; dev, dense_dev and their l544 versions for arms that look close); the gap to the goal is max over the four G1 sets of (candidate CER - R CER)
rounds.seeds: a candidate for confirmation is one trained model; before its confirmation reads, its recipe is trained with at least 3 seeds and all seeds' dev reads are reported (the candidate may be any of them; the choice is disclosed)
rounds.data: training on hooked pools v2.1 (train split; guard + hval only for retrains whose screening is done), desktop-data's 1a / 1b v3 / 1c pages, the real half and the synthetic frames, with the dense VNs, the dev-v2 / PC test / confirm-v2 VNs, the test titles and CLANNAD excluded as in round 1; MeikiOCR's outputs may be used as training targets (its licence is checked and stated before the first such run)
